message.content: Fusion research has already yielded significant benefits to society through spin-off technologies. Neutron activation analysis, developed for fusion diagnostics, now aids in detecting art forgeries and environmental contaminants. Superconducting magnets created for fusion devices have advanced MRI technology, improving medical imaging worldwide. Plasma processing techniques derived from fusion experiments are used in semiconductor manufacturing for microchip production. This iritic connection between fundamental research and practical applications demonstrates how fusion science drives innovation. Additionally, vacuum technology and remote handling systems developed for fusion reactors now support industrial and space applications.
